US Citizen Matthew VanDyke Faces NIA Probe, Seeks Specific Diet in Jail

American national Matthew VanDyke is currently the subject of an investigation by India's National Investigation Agency (NIA). VanDyke has also approached a Delhi court seeking a specific diet while in judicial custody. The court has requested a response from the NIA regarding his plea.
